review: issue-5008-recorded-migration-recovery-review-20260923: the file records, byte for byte, the SQL production applied as 20260917181100 on 2026-09-17 18:11:00Z. Of the 25 findings check-money-trigger-declared raised against it, 24 were text inside a $catalog$ JSON literal the migration passes to jsonb_array_elements() in order to ASSERT an existing catalogue, which the dollar-quote fix in the same change removes. The one real CREATE TRIGGER on a watched table is bound below: a refusal-only BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE guard on chip_ledger that writes nothing, declared in public.ca_declared_money_triggers on 2026-09-18 04:18:09Z by migration 20260918041452, whose file is already on main. fn_undeclared_money_triggers() returns zero rows platform-wide. The function hash is unaffected because pg_get_functiondef() always qualifies.
